svg.title: Undo with several people, and selection locks (Undo: step M5; locks built after M8)
svg.desc: Top: Alice moves a cube and the editor remembers the scene before and after her step. Bob recolours the same cube. When Alice presses Undo, only the position goes back, because the position still has the value her step gave it; the colour is Bob's and stays. If Bob had also moved the cube, that field would be left alone and a message would say so. Bottom: when Alice selects an object, her awareness record lists it as held. Bob's editor highlights it with her name and refuses to let him select or change it, or anything inside or around it, until she deselects it, is idle for 30 seconds or disconnects. If both select it at the same moment the lower client number keeps it.
svg.text: Undo with several people, and selection locks
Undo: step M5. Selection locks: built after M8. Nothing here is checked by the server: both are rules of the editors.
UNDO: ONLY WHAT MY STEP DID
1. Alice moves the cube
A step is recorded with the
scene before AND after it
(position 0 becomes 5).
2. Bob recolours it
His change arrives as a
change from outside: no step
in Alice's history.
3. Alice presses Undo
Field by field, on the scene as it is NOW: position is still 5,
the value her step gave it, so it goes back to 0. The colour was not
in her step, so Bob's stays. Labels, buttons and Redo work as offline.
If Bob had moved the cube too
The position is no longer the one Alice's step set, so it is left alone (Bob's wins) and a message says so.
SELECTION LOCKS: WHAT YOU HAVE SELECTED IS YOURS
4. Alice selects the cube
Her awareness record lists
it as held. No change has to
be made first.
5. Bob's editor reads it
The record is checked; the cube
gets her colour and her name,
also on its row in the list.
6. Bob cannot take it
"Alice is working on Cube right now."
Nothing on it, inside it or around it can be changed.
Free when she deselects, is idle 30 s, or leaves.
Both select at the same moment
Each is let in before the other's record arrives. Then the lower client number keeps the object and the other is taken off it, with a message.
Limits
Undo can still touch an object someone else holds. The server does not enforce locks: they stay a courtesy.
